NO.1 POLICE AND TRIAL BY THE IV A.C.M.M AT  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC:20638  CRL.P No. 593 of 2022 BENGALURU.I.A.NO.1/2022 FOR STAY.I.A.NO.1/2022 FILED BY THE ADVOCATE FOR THE PETITIONER PRAYING TO STAY THE INVESTIGATION BY THE RESPONDENT NO.1 IN CRL.NO.119/2021 PENDING BEFORE THE IV A.C.M.M, BENGALURU FOR THE REASONS STATED THEREIN.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo seeking to withdraw the petition.

The memo reads as follows:-
"The undersigned counsel appearing for the petitioner humbly prays before this Hon'ble Court and may kindly be pleased to permit to the petitioner to withdraw the above said petition has a petitioner as obtained the charge sheet before the Trial Court.
Hence the petitioner prefers to with draw the petition.

Hence the petitioners prays to dismiss the petition as withdrawn as not to press, in the interest of justice."
2. Memo is placed on record.
3. The petition is dismissed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
JUDGE DN Sri.
